output.summary: Perennial mint-family herb native to Western Europe and North Africa. The nominate subspecies is tufted, hairy and mint-scented, with dark green leaves and relatively large, dark flowers. The leaves can be infused for aromatic tea or added to cooked foods for a pungent flavour likened to marjoram and mint.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves can be infused as aromatic tea or added to cooked food for a pungent, marjoram-and-mint-like flavour.
